title: 第11章 这行水太深你把握不住第12章 果然你心里有我
slug: 都市修仙五年下山就无敌
content_zh:
给钱就算有缘人？
叶凡忍不住摇头，刚转身要走时，就听那位脸色虚弱的中年男人紧张道：
“李道长，我最近特别倒霉，想请您帮忙算算可有解决之法，您放心，我不差钱，事成之后重金酬谢。”
不差钱！
叶凡停住脚步。
李长生自信道：“且让老夫算上一卦。”
这位脏老道抓起铜钱起卦，一开始云淡风轻的，但看卦时神色渐渐凝重起来。
又接连起了几卦，可卦象让李长生深深皱起眉头。
面对眼神期盼的中年男人，李长生长叹一声：“此卦，难解！”
说罢，竟将刚刚收下的红包又退了回去。
这个动作。
让中年男人脸色惨变。
他叫宋庆，家境殷实，平常也信八卦风水，经朋友指点来到这位据传卦象很灵的李姓高人这算命，自然了解相关知识。
这一行讲究卦不空出，但有三种情况不收卦金。
一是阳寿将近者不收，二是大难临头不可避者不收，三是再无好运者不收。
联想到自己的情况，宋庆一颗心如坠冰窟，身体摇摇晃晃间摔倒在地。
他没起身，而是跪倒在地，用力磕了一个头：“李道长，求您出手救救我，我上有老下有小，不能死啊！”
“唉。”
李长生不再是吊儿郎当的模样，惋惜道：“老夫虽有几分手段，可也只是凭借卜卦之术混口饭吃，你霉运附体，是有一位实力远在老夫之上的高人想要你死，给你改了运道，一旦介入这桩因果，别说你了，哪怕老夫也要遭殃。”
“咚！”

宋庆心头巨震，难怪最近诸事不利喝凉水都塞牙，原来是有高人想要自己的命！
李长生劝道：“想想自己最近得罪了哪些人，放低姿态找到人家道个歉，折损十年二十年寿元，兴许还能活。”
宋庆绝望了：“李道长，我也不知道得罪了谁，难道没有其他解决办法吗？”
李长生摇了摇头。
大部分算命先生都是江湖骗子，胡诌海扯一通骗钱。
少部分如他这般有几分真本事，能算出吉凶福祸，但也仅此而已了。
最多在求卦者富贵临门前添几句好话讨个彩头，或者命里有难时提醒一下，做得都是可有可无之事。
而能折损运道致人霉运附体这种手段，只有极少数高人才可以，他距离那个层次太远了。
看懂。
跟做到。
是两码事。
差距之大，可谓天堑！
宋庆失魂落魄，整个人瘫软在地没了力气。
叶凡淡淡道：“遭人咒了而已，我能解决。”
李长生闻言一愣，似笑非笑道：“原来是同行，难怪刚才要让老夫算上一卦，这是要来试探老夫深浅。”
叶凡很客气：“同行算不上，只是会点相面卜卦之术，让您老见笑了。”
“小伙子，听老夫一句劝，风水这行水太深你把握不住。”
李长生一指宋庆，严肃道：“他这必死之卦，谁碰谁倒霉，小心因果缠身损了阴德，下辈子投不了胎。”
“这就不劳老先生费心了。”
“不知死活！”

李长生懒得劝了，这一行多得是不自量力想要逆天改命的白痴，最后死的都很惨。
“这位道长，您也是风水先生？”
中年男子回过神，像是抓住救命稻草般看向叶凡。
“略懂一二，在下昆仑山玉女观弟子叶无玄。”
叶凡做了个拱手礼，无玄是师父为他起的道号。
content_en:
Does giving money count as a fate?
Ye Fan couldn't help but shake his head. Just when he turned to leave, he heard the middle-aged man with a weak face say nervously:
"Daozhang Li, I've been very unlucky recently. I'd like to ask you to help me figure out a solution. Don't worry, I'm not short of money. I'll give you a big reward when the job is done."
Not short of money!
Ye Fan stopped.
Li Changsheng said confidently: "Let me calculate the fortune."
The dirty old Taoist grabbed the copper coins and began to read the hexagram. He was calm and relaxed at first, but his expression gradually became serious as he read the hexagram.
Several more hexagrams were played in succession, but the hexagram images made Li Changsheng frown deeply.
Facing the middle-aged man with expectant eyes, Li Changsheng sighed: "This hexagram is difficult to understand!"
After that, he actually returned the red envelope he just accepted.
This action.
The middle-aged man's face turned pale.
His name is Song Qing, he comes from a wealthy family, and he usually believes in Bagua Feng Shui. After being recommended by a friend, he came to the fortune teller of this master surnamed Li, who is said to be very good at hexagrams, so he naturally understood the relevant knowledge.
This line of work emphasizes that hexagrams should not be left empty, but there are three situations in which hexagram gold will not be collected.
First, don’t accept it if your longevity is approaching; second, don’t accept it if you are facing an unavoidable disaster; third, don’t accept it if you have no more good luck.
Thinking of his own situation, Song Qing's heart felt like it was falling into an ice cave, and his body staggered and fell to the ground.
He did not get up, but knelt down on the ground and kowtowed hard: "Daozhang Li, please save me. I have an old man above me and a young man below me. I can't die!"
"Alas."
Li Changsheng no longer looked like a fool, and said regretfully: "Although I have some skills, I can only make a living by relying on divination. You are possessed by bad luck. There is an expert who is far more powerful than me. He wants you to die and changes your destiny. Once you get involved in this cause and effect, let alone you, even I will suffer."
"Boom!"
Song Qing's heart was greatly shocked. No wonder his teeth were blocked when he drank cold water due to bad things lately. It turned out that there was an expert who wanted to kill him!
Li Changsheng advised: "Think about the people you have offended recently, lower your profile and go to them to apologize. If you lose ten or twenty years of your life, you may still be able to live."
Song Qing was desperate: "Daozhang Li, I don't know who I offended. Is there no other solution?"
Li Changsheng shook his head.
Most fortune tellers are charlatans, trying to get money by making nonsense.
A few people like him have some real ability and can calculate good and bad luck, but that's all.
At most, you can add a few good words to the seeker before he or she gets rich or rich, or remind him when he is in trouble. This is all dispensable.
As for the method of damaging luck and causing people to possess bad luck, only a very few experts can do it. He is too far away from that level.
Understand.
Just do it.
They are two different things.
The gap is so huge that it can be described as a chasm!
Song Qing was so distraught that he collapsed on the ground with no strength.
Ye Fan said calmly: "It's just a curse, I can solve it."
Li Changsheng was stunned when he heard this, and said with a half-smile: "So we are colleagues. No wonder you asked me to make a fortune just now. This is to test my depth."
Ye Fan was very polite: "I don't count as a colleague. I just know the art of fortune telling and make you laugh all the time."
"Young man, take my advice, Feng Shui is too deep for you to master."
Li Changsheng pointed at Song Qing and said seriously: "His hexagram of death means whoever touches it will be unlucky. Be careful of the entanglement of karma and the damage to your moral character. You will not be able to be reborn in the next life."
"I don't need to worry about it, old man."
"I don't know whether to live or die!"
Li Changsheng was too lazy to persuade him. There were so many idiots in this industry who overestimated their abilities and tried to change their lives against fate, and they all died miserably in the end.
"Taoist priest, are you also a Feng Shui master?"
The middle-aged man came back to his senses and looked at Mark as if grasping a life-saving straw.
"I know a little bit about it. I'm Ye Wuxuan, a disciple of the Jade Girl Temple in Kunlun Mountain."
Ye Fan made a hand gesture, Wu Xuan was the name given to him by his master.
